title: Comparison of uniformly bounded hypercohomology spectral sequences
statement: Let $I$ be a small directed set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i\in I$ let $(E_{r,i}^{p,q})_{r\geq1}$ be a cohomological spectral sequence of abelian groups [def-sp-spectral-sequence], indexed with $p$ the cohomological degree and $q$ the filtration degree, with differentials $d_{r,i}:E_{r,i}^{p,q}\to E_{r,i}^{p-r+1,q+r}$ for every $r\geq1$. Let $(E_r^{p,q})_{r\geq1}$ be another such spectral sequence, with differentials $d_r:E_r^{p,q}\to E_r^{p-r+1,q+r}$ for every $r\geq1$. Give the first family transition morphisms of spectral sequences $u_{i'i}:E_{\bullet,i}\to E_{\bullet,i'}$ for $i'\geq i$, satisfying the identity and composition laws, and give compatible morphisms $v_i:E_{\bullet,i}\to E_\bullet$. For every $n$, let $A_i^n$ and $A^n$ be abelian groups with decreasing filtrations $F^qA_i^n$ and $F^qA^n$ [def-sp-filtration]. Give filtered transition homomorphisms $a_{i'i}^n:A_i^n\to A_{i'}^n$ satisfying the identity and composition laws, and filtered homomorphisms $b_i^n:A_i^n\to A^n$ with $b_{i'}^n a_{i'i}^n=b_i^n$. Suppose that $u_{i'i}$ and $v_i$ induce $a_{i'i}^n$ and $b_i^n$ on abutments, and that for every $i,p,q$ the convergence isomorphisms $E_{\infty,i}^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q A_i^{p+q}$ and $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q A^{p+q}$ commute with these morphisms. Assume (i) $\varinjlim_i E_{1,i}^{p,q}\to E_1^{p,q}$ induced by $v_i$ is an isomorphism for every $(p,q)$; (ii) one integer $a$ works for all $i$ and for $E$: their $E_1^{p,q}$ vanish if $p<0$ or $q<a$; (iii) all pages stabilize in each bidegree to the displayed $E_\infty$; and (iv) for every $n$, the filtrations have $F^qA_i^n=A_i^n$ and $F^qA^n=A^n$ for $q\leq a$, and $F^qA_i^n=F^qA^n=0$ for $q>n$, compatibly for all $i$. Then the homomorphism $\varinjlim_i A_i^n\to A^n$ induced by the $b_i^n$ is an isomorphism for every $n$.

proof.text: For each page r, take the filtered colimit of the page complexes and their differentials. Exactness of filtered colimits in Ab [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-abelian-groups-exact] identifies the colimit of kernels and images with the kernel and image of the colimit differential. Starting from the assumed E_1 isomorphism and inducting on r, the induced map from the colimit of E_{r,i}^{p,q} to E_r^{p,q} is therefore an isomorphism in every bidegree; the page-to-page homology identifications are those in the definition of a spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence].

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, passage from the E_1 page through successive pages

proof.text: The common vanishing region $p<0$ or $q<a$ is preserved on every page by the page-to-page homology identifications. Fix $(p,q)$ in the remaining region. By the bidegree assumed in the statement, the outgoing target of $d_r$ is $(p-r+1,q+r)$ and vanishes for $r>p+1$, while the incoming source is $(p+r-1,q-r)$ and vanishes for $r>q-a$. Thus $R(p,q)=\max(p+1,q-a)+1$, independent of $i$, has $E_{R,i}^{p,q}=E_{\infty,i}^{p,q}$ and $E_R^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$ via the assumed stabilization. Step 1 at page $R$, followed by the assumed compatibility of the convergence isomorphisms with $u_{i'i}$ and $v_i$, gives $\varinjlim_i \operatorname{gr}^q A_i^{p+q}\cong \operatorname{gr}^q A^{p+q}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, boundedness and finite-term spectral-sequence comparison

proof.text: Fix $n$. By the filtration bounds, $F^qA_i^n=A_i^n$ and $F^qA^n=A^n$ for $q\leq a$, while $F^qA_i^n=F^qA^n=0$ for $q>n$; hence only the finite range $a\leq q\leq n$ occurs. For $q$ descending from $n$ to $a$, use the short exact sequences $0\to F^{q+1}A_i^n\to F^qA_i^n\to \operatorname{gr}^qA_i^n\to0$ and their compatible maps to the corresponding sequence for $A^n$. Filtered-colimit exactness [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-abelian-groups-exact] preserves these sequences. The induction starts at $q>n$, where all terms vanish, and the graded isomorphism of Step 2 together with the five lemma [lem-weil-pbc-five-lemma] gives an isomorphism at each successive $q$. At $q\leq a$ this identifies the canonical map $\varinjlim_iA_i^n\to A^n$ with an isomorphism. Since $n$ was arbitrary, the result holds for every $n$.
